buildCommand: export PATH=$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release
installCommand: FLUTTER_VERSION=3.24.0 && FLUTTER_SDK=$HOME/flutter && mkdir -p $FLUTTER_SDK && cd /tmp && curl -L https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_${FLUTTER_VERSION}-stable.tar.xz -o f.tar.xz && tar xf f.tar.xz && mv flutter/* $FLUTTER_SDK/ && rm -rf flutter f.tar.xz && export PATH=$FLUTTER_SDK/bin:$PATH
